overview: This 353-page file traces the handling of patent and other intellectual property rights in Japan from wartime transfers through the Allied occupation. Extensive General Electric patent schedules accompany company claims for royalties and restored rights, State Department correspondence, policy proposals, surveys of Japanese law, and SCAP directives on patents and trademarks.
interest: Detailed patent schedules connect individual corporate claims to the occupation policies that governed their recovery.
